subject: Quick check on the van purchase
text:
Hey all,

Just wanted to chase up that van we grabbed for the weekend market. Did the receipt ever land in the shared folder? I was digging through my inbox and couldn't find it, and I reckon it's easier to catch it now than when the books are due. Also, heads-up: there was a little extra charge on the card after the pickup because the tank wasn't full. It was only a few dollars, but it did creep into the cost estimate. Nothing scary, just one of those 'oops, we thought we'd returned it earlier' bits. Could someone check whether the fuel receipt got added to the folder? I can sort the split later so nobody ends up carrying it all. Thanks loads, and let's hope next outing involves fewer surprises and more doughnuts. I'll pop a reminder in the calendar too, just so the paperwork doesn't vanish into the ether.

Cheers,
